laws.rule: Walking around town in swimwear or undressed is fined €350 (about A$556 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) to €500 (about A$795 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) (as reported by RTV Budva quoting municipal officials).
laws.heading: Swimwear in town
